summary: syrp-peer-api (increment 2): pointer events (mouse, touch, pen with pressure, tilt and source ids), wheel and magnify events, drag-and-drop of files and text with Peer::accept_drop, cursor-icon cursors via Peer::set_cursor, and raw-window-handle HasWindowHandle on Peer and HasDisplayHandle on Desktop; the headless desktop records and enforces all of these.
